description: Find tradespeople and local service providers in a named place and show which have set themselves free now or free soon on Speedi. Providers set their own light (green = free now, amber = free soon, red = busy) and it expires on a timer, so each result says when the light was set and when it lapses. Search by where the work is, which may not be where the person asking is. Covers building trades (plumber, electrician, roofer, locksmith, decorator) and everyday services (cleaner, driver, airport transfer, courier, hairdresser, dog walker, concierge, event planner). Coverage is across the UK, densest in Lancashire, with smaller presences in Ibiza, Pattaya, Dubai and Las Vegas; each result reports coverage for the area. Read-only.

credential.description: A qualification or cover the person asked for, e.g. "Gas Safe", "NICEIC", "NAPIT", "DBS", or "insured". Only providers whose certificate Speedi has checked are returned, so this may return nobody; that means Speedi has not seen the certificate locally, not that no qualified provider exists.

job.description: What needs doing, in the person's words, e.g. "landlord gas safety check", "EICR", "blocked drain". Pass it alongside trade when they describe a task; Speedi uses it to search the right trade and to note any legal requirement for the job.

lat.description: Latitude, if you have it instead of a postcode.

lng.description: Longitude, if you have it instead of a postcode.

postcode.description: Where the work is (not necessarily where the person is): a UK postcode or outcode such as "PR6 8BZ" or "PR6", or a place name such as "Blackburn" or "Ibiza".

radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles. Defaults to 10.

trade.description: What is wanted, in the person's words, e.g. "plumber", "cleaner", "airport transfer". Omit to see everyone in the area.
